Name: Em's Hedgehogs
Author: Rivalrabbit
Description:
Add little prickly hedgehogs to the coop to gather fruit during off-seasons
A small mod to add a sweet critter between the farm animals here and there
Available for Content Patcher

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/tJ7k4mfk/Plum-Find.png[/img]﻿

Hedgehogs are quickly content as long as they have some grass to hide between and a safe place to sleep
As a sign of appreciation, they leave some of their gathered fruit for you every other morning
This can be either a [color=#e69138]plum[/color], an [color=#e69138]apricot[/color], a [color=#e69138]blackberry[/color] or a [color=#e69138]salmonberry[/color]
Because they are small, they only need a regular coop as a house

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/W1HQ4bKW/CP.png[/img]

Download and install the latest [url=https://smapi.io///]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher
[/url]Download and unzip "Em's Hedgehogs"
Move the folder to \Stardew Valley\Mods\
Enjoy!

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/MGb2cDyd/Patchnotes.png[/img]

[i]Update 1.1 Possibility added to get an albino hedgehog[/i]
[i]Update 1.2 Added translation file. Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20528?tab=description]﻿Otter's Additional Coop Animals

[/url]Important update notes on 1.2 for those who have Otter's Additional Coop Animals installed
Load Em's Hedgehogs first, then add Otter's Additional Coop Animals after a reload
This prevents any of Otter's previously bought Hedgehogs from becoming an Em's version[/i]
